d75cc4.title: Application Overview - OWASP Juice Shop
d75cc4.content:
## Application Type & Framework
**OWASP Juice Shop** - Deliberately vulnerable web application for security training.
- **Architecture**: Single-Page Application (SPA) built with Angular
- **Backend**: Express.js ^4.22.1 (Node.js)
- **Database**: Likely SQLite or similar (based on API responses showing JSON structure)
- **License**: MIT (2014-2026 Bjoern Kimminich & OWASP Juice Shop contributors)

## Technology Stack

### Frontend
- **Framework**: Angular (latest, lazy-loaded components)
- **UI Framework**: Angular Material Design
- **Styling**: Material Design Color Scheme (bluegrey-lightgreen-theme)
- **Font**: VT323 (Google Fonts)
- **Build**: Webpack/Rolldown with minified chunks
- **Notable Libraries**: cookie-consent, possibly Web3 libraries

### Backend
- **Runtime**: Node.js
- **Framework**: Express.js ^4.22.1
- **Components**: 
  - Authentication middleware (verify.js)
  - Route handling (angular.js)
  - Security/insecurity module
  - Utility functions (utils.js)
- **Build**: JavaScript bundles in `/build/` directory

### Security Features (Present)
- CORS enabled (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *)
- X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
- X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN
- Feature-Policy: payment 'self'
- JWT-based authentication (Authorization headers)
- CAPTCHA on certain endpoints

## Key Pages & Routes (Discovered)

### Public Routes
- `/#/` - Home/Product Listing
- `/#/login` - User Login
- `/#/register` - User Registration
- `/#/forgot-password` - Password Reset
- `/#/contact` - Contact Us
- `/#/about` - About Page
- `/#/photo-wall` - Photo Wall
- `/#/search` - Product Search
- `/#/basket` - Shopping Basket
- `/#/order-history` - Order History
- `/#/order-summary` - Order Summary
- `/#/order-completion` - Order Completion
- `/#/delivery-method` - Delivery Options
- `/#/delivery-status` - Delivery Tracking
- `/#/payment` - Payment Page
- `/#/recycle` - Recycling Program
- `/#/wallet` - Wallet/Balance
- `/#/wallet-web3` - Web3 Wallet
- `/#/faucet` - Faucet (possibly crypto-related)
- `/#/coding-challenge` - Coding Challenge
- `/#/coding-challenge-page` - Coding Challenge Page
- `/#/jobs` - Job Listings (from X-Recruiting header)
- `/#/admin` - Admin Dashboard (requires auth)

### Special Features
- AI Chat functionality
- Beginners Tutorial
- Deluxe Membership
- 2FA setup/verification
- Security Questions for authentication
- Password reset flow

## API Endpoints (Discovered)

### Product & Catalog APIs
- `GET /api/Products` - List all products (public, no auth required)
- `GET /rest/products` - Alternative products endpoint (may be deprecated)
- `GET /rest/products/search` - Search products
- `GET /products/juicy_chatbot` - AI Chatbot product
- `GET /products/owasp-juice-shop/794` - Specific product detail

### User & Account APIs
- `GET /rest/user/whoami` - Current user info (shows empty {} if unauthenticated)
- `POST /rest/user/login` - Login endpoint
- `POST /rest/user/authentication-details/{id}` - Authentication details
- `POST /rest/user/change-password` - Change password
- `POST /rest/user/reset-password` - Password reset
- `POST /rest/user/security-question` - Security question handling
- `GET /api/Users` - List users (requires Authorization header - 401 error if missing)
- `GET /api/SecurityQuestions` - Security questions
- `GET /api/SecurityAnswers` - Security answers

### Authentication & Security APIs
- `POST /rest/2fa/setup` - Two-Factor Authentication setup
- `POST /rest/2fa/verify` - Verify 2FA code
- `GET /rest/2fa/status` - Check 2FA status
- `POST /rest/2fa/disable` - Disable 2FA
- `POST /rest/captcha` - CAPTCHA validation
- `GET /rest/image-captcha/{id}` - CAPTCHA image
- `POST /rest/saveLoginIp` - Save login IP

### Shopping APIs
- `GET /api/BasketItems` - Basket contents
- `POST /rest/basket/{id}` - Manage basket
- `GET /api/Quantitys` - Quantity information
- `GET /api/Deliverys` - Delivery options
- `GET /api/Cards` - Payment cards
- `POST /rest/delivery-method` - Set delivery method

### Order & Transaction APIs
- `GET /rest/order-history` - User order history
- `POST /rest/track-order` - Track specific order
- `GET /api/Orders` (inferred) - Order list
- `GET /api/Complaints` - Complaints/returns

### Wallet & Financial APIs
- `GET /rest/wallet/balance` - Wallet balance
- `POST /rest/wallet` (inferred) - Wallet operations
- `GET /rest/web3` - Web3 integration
- `GET /walletExploitAddress` - Suspicious wallet endpoint
- `GET /walletNFTVerify` - NFT verification

### Membership & Features
- `POST /rest/deluxe-membership` - Premium membership signup
- `GET /rest/country-mapping` - Country list

### Coding Challenge & Learning APIs
- `GET /api/Challenges` - List challenges
- `POST /rest/continue-code` - Continue code challenge
- `POST /rest/continue-code/apply/{id}` - Apply code fix
- `POST /rest/continue-code-findIt` - Find It challenge
- `POST /rest/continue-code-findIt/apply/{id}` - Apply fix
- `POST /rest/continue-code-fixIt` - Fix It challenge
- `POST /rest/continue-code-fixIt/apply/{id}` - Apply fix

### User-Generated Content APIs
- `GET /api/Feedbacks` - User feedback
- `POST /rest/memories` - Memory/achievement tracking
- `GET /reviews` (inferred) - Product reviews
- `GET /api/Hints` - Hints for challenges
- `GET /rest/admin` - Admin endpoints

### System & Configuration APIs
- `GET /rest/languages` - Supported languages
- `GET /rest/repeat-notification` - Repeat notifications
- `POST /rest/chat` - Chat/messaging
- `GET /redirect?to=<url>` - Redirect endpoint (potential open redirect vulnerability)

### Address & Location
- `GET /api/Addresss` - Address management (note the typo with triple 's')

## Security Observations

### Positive Controls
- JWT-based authentication with Authorization header requirements
- CORS properly configured (not completely open)
- X-Frame-Options set to SAMEORIGIN
- CAPTCHA implementation on feedback/registration
- 2FA support available
- Security questions for additional authentication

### Potential Vulnerabilities (Expected - Training App)
- Open `/redirect` endpoint with `to` parameter (open redirect indicator)
- CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (cross-origin requests allowed)
- Public product endpoints with no authentication
- Some routes may have IDOR issues (typical for training)
- API endpoint naming conventions (plural resources like /api/Users, /api/Products)
- Exposed balance endpoints (/rest/wallet/balance)
- Suspicious endpoints like /walletExploitAddress

### Error Handling
- Verbose error messages revealing internal paths (/juice-shop/build/...)
- Stack traces in error responses
- Clear indication of missing Authorization headers

## User Roles (Likely)
- **Anonymous**: Can browse products, view challenges, access public pages
- **Registered User**: Can login, place orders, access account features
- **Admin**: Full access, admin dashboard at /#/admin
- **Deluxe Member**: Premium membership with discounts (deluxePrice field on products)

## Notable Features
- E-commerce platform (buying juice products)
- Security training challenges (Juice Shop CTF)
- Web3/Crypto integration (wallets, NFT verification)
- AI chatbot integration
- Two-factor authentication
- Photo wall/social features
- Recycling program
- Password reset/recovery flows
- Delivery tracking
- Payment processing

## Deployment Info
- Port: 3100 (HTTP)
- Host: host.docker.internal (Docker container)
- Path to application: /juice-shop (from error messages)
- Express version in errors suggests dynamic server

## URLs Requiring Attention
- `/redirect?to=` endpoints (potential open redirect)
- `/walletExploitAddress` (suspicious naming)
- `/walletNFTVerify` (possible exploit point)
- Admin dashboard at /#/admin
- Web3 integration endpoints

09de53.title: Authentication, Sessions & Security Analysis
09de53.content:
## Authentication Mechanism

### Login Flow & Credentials
- **Endpoint**: `POST /rest/user/login`
- **Request Format**: JSON with `email` and `password`
- **Response**: JWT token in `authentication.token` field
- **Default Admin**: `admin@juice-sh.op` / `admin123` (known OWASP Juice Shop credential)

### JWT Token Structure
**Algorithm**: RS256 (RSA Signature - asymmetric)
**Header**:
```json
{
  "typ": "JWT",
  "alg": "RS256"
}
```

**Payload** (Contains sensitive data):
```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "username": "",
    "email": "admin@juice-sh.op",
    "password": "0192023a7bbd73250516f069df18b500",  // MD5 HASH EMBEDDED!
    "role": "admin",
    "deluxeToken": "",
    "lastLoginIp": "",
    "profileImage": "assets/public/images/uploads/defaultAdmin.png",
    "totpSecret": "",  // TOTP/2FA secret if configured
    "isActive": true,
    "createdAt": "2026-09-04 15:44:45.804 +00:00",
    "updatedAt": "2026-09-04 15:44:45.804 +00:00",
    "deletedAt": null
  },
  "bid": 1,
  "iat": 1788536924  // Issued at timestamp
}
```

### Critical JWT Vulnerability
**SENSITIVE DATA IN JWT**: The password hash and user details are embedded in the JWT token. This is exposed to:
- Any script running in the browser (XSS vulnerability)
- Any intermediary that can inspect tokens
- Client-side token inspection by attacker

### Session Management
- **Token Storage**: Browser localStorage/sessionStorage (JWT tokens)
- **Authorization Header**: `Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>`
- **"Remember Me"**: Checkbox on login page maintains session across browser restarts
- **No visible token expiration**: `/iat` claim shows issued-at time but no expiry observed
- **Token Validation**: Server-side RS256 signature verification (requires public key)

## Authentication-Related Endpoints

### User Authentication
- `POST /rest/user/login` - Main login endpoint
- `GET /rest/user/whoami` - Get current user info (returns {} when authenticated - possible bug)
- `POST /rest/user/authentication-details/{id}` - Authentication details by user ID
- `GET /api/Users` - List all users (requires token)

### Account Management
- `POST /rest/user/change-password` - Change password
- `POST /rest/user/reset-password` - Reset forgotten password
- `POST /rest/user/security-question` - Security question handling

### Security Features
- `POST /rest/2fa/setup` - Enable two-factor authentication
- `POST /rest/2fa/verify` - Verify 2FA code
- `GET /rest/2fa/status` - Check 2FA status
- `POST /rest/2fa/disable` - Disable 2FA
- `POST /rest/captcha` - CAPTCHA validation
- `GET /rest/image-captcha/{id}` - CAPTCHA image generation

## Security Findings & Observations

### Confirmed Vulnerabilities (Training App)

1. **Sensitive Data in JWT Token**
   - User password hash (MD5) is embedded in JWT
   - User ID, email, role are plaintext in JWT
   - TOTP secret is included (if 2FA enabled)
   - Impact: XSS can extract credentials, token inspection reveals user data

2. **Known Default Credentials**
   - Admin account: `admin@juice-sh.op` / `admin123`
   - This is intentional OWASP Juice Shop design for training

3. **No Token Expiration Observed**
   - JWT has `iat` (issued-at) but no `exp` (expiration) observed
   - Tokens may be valid indefinitely
   - Impact: Stolen tokens remain valid forever

4. **API Returns All Users**
   - `GET /api/Users` returns all users with details
   - No pagination observed, complete user enumeration possible
   - Returns: id, username, email, role, profile image, timestamps, isActive status

5. **Missing Authentication on Some Endpoints**
   - `/api/Products` - Public (no auth needed)
   - `/api/Challenges` - Public (no auth needed)
   - `/api/SecurityQuestions` - Public (no auth needed)
   - Impact: Information gathering for attackers

### Potential Vulnerabilities (Likely by Design)

1. **JWT Algorithm Confusion**
   - RS256 is asymmetric, but server might accept HS256
   - Attacker could re-sign tokens if symmetric key is weak
   - Would allow privilege escalation

2. **JWT Token Claims Manipulation**
   - `role` field in JWT might not be re-verified server-side
   - Could modify from "user" to "admin" and re-sign with weak key

3. **Weak Password Hash**
   - Passwords hashed with MD5 (very weak, fast to crack)
   - Example: 0192023a7bbd73250516f069df18b500 = "admin123" (easily rainbow-tabled)

4. **User ID Sequential/Predictable**
   - User ID = 1 for admin (suggests sequential IDs)
   - IDOR attacks possible: modify ID to access other users
   - Endpoints: `/api/Users/{id}`, `/api/Addresss/{id}`, etc.

5. **Security Questions Public**
   - All security questions accessible without authentication
   - Question options: "Your eldest siblings middle name?", "Mother's maiden name?", etc.
   - Answers may be guessable or found in OSINT
   - Can bypass password reset

6. **No CSRF Tokens Observed**
   - POST endpoints don't seem to require CSRF tokens
   - Vulnerable to CSRF attacks on state-changing operations

### Positive Security Controls

1. **RS256 Signature Verification**
   - Asymmetric signing requires server private key to forge
   - Protects against token modification without key access

2. **Authorization Header Enforcement**
   - Protected endpoints return 401 if no Authorization header
   - Prevents unauthenticated access to user-specific APIs

3. **2FA Support**
   - Optional two-factor authentication available
   - TOTP-based (Time-based One-Time Password)
   - If enabled, provides additional account security

4. **CAPTCHA on Forms**
   - Feedback/contact form requires CAPTCHA
   - Prevents automated spam
   - CAPTCHA bypass may be possible (typical training vulnerability)

## User Roles & Access Levels

### Identified Roles
1. **Anonymous**: No role, no token
   - Access: Public products, login page, registration
   - Denied: Order history, addresses, admin functions

2. **User**: role="user" in JWT
   - Access: Shopping cart, orders, account profile, addresses
   - Can only modify own resources (IDOR vulnerability if not checked)

3. **Admin**: role="admin" in JWT
   - Access: `/api/Users`, admin dashboard, all user data
   - Expected to have full system access

4. **Deluxe Member**: Implied from `deluxeToken` and `deluxePrice` fields
   - Access: Regular user features
   - Benefit: Discounted pricing on all products (deluxePrice field)

### Role Escalation Vectors (Likely)
- JWT manipulation (change role from user to admin)
- Weak key making token forgery possible
- CSRF on role assignment endpoint (if exists)
- SQL injection in role query

## Known Issues Summary

| Issue | Severity | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| Password hash in JWT | HIGH | XSS exposes credentials |
| MD5 password hashing | HIGH | Weak algorithm, easily cracked |
| No token expiration | HIGH | Stolen tokens valid forever |
| Known default creds | MEDIUM | admin@juice-sh.op / admin123 |
| User enumeration | MEDIUM | /api/Users lists all users |
| IDOR likely | HIGH | Sequential IDs, no access checks likely |
| Weak CAPTCHA | MEDIUM | Likely bypassable |
| No CSRF tokens | HIGH | State changes vulnerable to CSRF |
| JWT algorithm confusion | MEDIUM | May accept HS256 instead of RS256 |

## Testing Recommendations

1. **Try to register/login with various email formats**
   - SQL injection in email field
   - Email enumeration/validation bypass

2. **Attempt token manipulation**
   - Change role from "user" to "admin"
   - Modify id field to access other users

3. **Test IDOR on user endpoints**
   - Access other users' addresses: `/api/Addresss/2`
   - Access other users' orders via ID manipulation

4. **Test for brute force protection**
   - Attempt many failed logins to `/rest/user/login`
   - Check for rate limiting or account lockout

5. **Password reset flow**
   - Check for token prediction/brute force
   - Attempt race conditions
   - Email enumeration via reset endpoint

6. **Business logic attacks**
   - Attempt price manipulation in basket
   - Attempt to claim deluxe discount without membership
   - Attempt negative quantities or overflow

## Endpoint Summary

**Public (No Auth Required)**: 12+ endpoints
- Product APIs, languages, security questions, challenges, CAPTCHA

**Protected (Auth Required)**: 15+ endpoints  
- User management, orders, addresses, wallet, admin features

**Suspicious**: `/redirect?to=<url>`, `/walletExploitAddress`, `/walletNFTVerify`
- Likely intentional training vulnerabilities
